reasoning: A congruence ax≡b (mod n) has gcd(a,n) solutions if that gcd divides b, and none otherwise. I: gcd(4,20)=4 does not divide 9, so there are no solutions. II: gcd(12,20)=4 divides 16, giving four solutions. III: gcd(8,20)=4 divides 12, giving four solutions. Thus II and III only is correct.
